verdict.rationale: First-party docs state you can deploy a dedicated instance on A100, H100, H200, B200 or B300 GPUs with autoscaling and a private endpoint, aimed at teams that need data isolation. This directly matches the core of the story. The coverage is only short marketing-style docs snippets, though, with no detail on how autoscaling is configured or how isolation works. Missing for 10: in-depth deployment and autoscaling configuration docs (min/max replicas, scaling triggers), explicit documentation of isolation from the shared serverless pool, independent or hands-on corroboration.
